objective: Enforce explicit watchdog timeouts, cap worker exponential retry backoff to 15s to prevent blocked stalls after transient tunnel restarts, and establish physical Indian Quiz verification harness.

rulesConsidered: Worker daemons must enforce bounded timeouts on all control plane HTTP communication.
Exponential backoff must have a deterministic upper bound to prevent extended unresponsiveness.
Worker heartbeats must maintain active pool eligibility without accumulating stale failure states.
Physical compute workers require strict per-worker credential isolation with zero generic fallback.
F06 Container Verification and F07 9-gate media audit remain authoritative production truth.
No secrets, private keys, or tokens may be committed to repository history.

forensicFindings: During control plane microVM sleep/wake cycles, transient network timeouts caused worker agent loops to stall with unhandled read timeouts.
Exponential backoff in worker loop had no strict upper bound ceiling, risking extended latency in rejoining the healthy worker pool.
The 11-node bare-metal fleet required reconnection to the active control plane public tunnel endpoint (https://3000-agq3mvsv7rj7orgrsuc3v2zwea.instabox.tech).
changes: Enforced explicit timeouts in services/instabox-agent/agent.py (HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=5.0, CLAIM_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=10.0, PROGRESS_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=10.0, CALLBACK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS=15.0).
Capped exponential retry backoff to MAX_BACKOFF_SECONDS = 15.0 in services/instabox-agent/agent.py and services/rendering-engine/worker_daemon.py.
Bounded main worker polling loop sleep to min(MAX_BACKOFF_SECONDS, POLL_INTERVAL_SECONDS).
Reconnected and verified all 11 eligible bare-metal workers (box2..box8, box10..box13) in healthy status with fresh heartbeats (<15s), keeping box9 strictly quarantined.
Deployed hardened agent.py across all active fleet workers.

Created Indian Quiz Short render and verification harness scripts/instabox/render_indian_quiz.py and executed physical render on instabox-box2 (18.82s, CAS SHA-256 77cfc8f6b568ad4e73e6e5ba0e0e1f0f0c0693703c6ead6dd1cd5cdf53b4a78b, 634,146 bytes, F06 PASS, F07 96/100).
